name: Metallica

whyMatters.en: Los Angeles / Bay Area thrash band formed in 1981. Master of Puppets (1986) and the Black Album (1991) scaled underground speed metal to mainstream rock radio.
whyMatters.zh: 洛杉矶/湾区 thrash 乐队，1981 年成立。Master of Puppets（1986）与黑专（1991）把地下速度金属扩到主流摇滚电台。

note.zh: 长形式 thrash 编曲峰值。
电台时长 riff + 口号副歌。

interviewQuotes.text: We play metal. That's what we do.

interviewQuotes.speaker: Lars Ulrich

shortBio.en: Hetfield / Ulrich thrash-to-arena metal; Enter Sandman is the mass radio turn.
shortBio.zh: Hetfield / Ulrich 从 thrash 到体育场金属；Enter Sandman 是大众电台转折。

body.en:
Formed in 1981. Kill ’Em All through …And Justice for All document thrash precision across the Cliff Burton and Jason Newsted bass eras; the Black Album (Bob Rock) shortens songs for rock radio.

Master of Puppets (1986), One (1988), and Enter Sandman (1991) show long thrash forms, ballad-metal drama, and riff-chorus mainstream writing.

Hetfield answered Ulrich’s ad; the first single Hit the Lights used roommate Ron McGovney on bass and Lloyd Grant as a temporary guitarist, then Dave Mustaine. After Cliff Burton replaced McGovney they moved north to Burton’s Bay Area. Record-store owner Jon Zazula got Megaforce to issue Kill ’Em All (1983) once Kirk Hammett, from Exodus, had replaced Mustaine. Ride the Lightning (1984) and Master of Puppets (1986) followed a US tour with Ozzy Osbourne. Burton died in a tour-bus crash in Sweden in 1986. Jason Newsted, from Flotsam and Jetsam, first appears on The $5.98 E.P.: Garage Days Re-Revisited (1987) and …And Justice for All (1988). The Black Album (1991) dropped the early thrash writing, pushed the bass up, and sold about 15 million in the US. The book says the tense 1992 co-headline with Guns N’ Roses left Metallica ahead. Garage Inc. (1998) and S&M (1999, with the San Francisco Symphony) came next. St. Anger (2003) and the film Some Kind of Monster cover rehab and Newsted’s exit; Robert Trujillo, from Suicidal Tendencies and Ozzy Osbourne’s band, took bass. Death Magnetic (2008), the 2010 Big Four tour, and Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction sit in the same year in the entry. The December 2011 30th-anniversary shows used guests Dave Mustaine, Ozzy Osbourne, Geezer Butler, Jerry Cantrell, and Rob Halford.
body.zh:
1981 年组建。从 Kill ’Em All 到 …And Justice for All 记录 thrash 精密，覆盖 Cliff Burton 与 Jason Newsted 贝斯时期；黑专（Bob Rock）缩短歌曲以进摇滚电台。

Master of Puppets（1986）、One（1988）、Enter Sandman（1991）展示长 thrash 曲式、谣曲—金属戏剧，以及 riff-副歌主流写法。

Hetfield 回应 Ulrich 的广告；第一首单曲 Hit the Lights 用室友 Ron McGovney 弹贝斯、Lloyd Grant 临时吉他，随后是 Dave Mustaine。Cliff Burton 接替 McGovney 后，乐队北迁到 Burton 所在的湾区。唱片店老板 Jon Zazula 促成 Megaforce 发行 Kill ’Em All（1983），此时来自 Exodus 的 Kirk Hammett 已接替 Mustaine。Ride the Lightning（1984）与 Master of Puppets（1986）在与 Ozzy Osbourne 的美国巡演之后。Burton 1986 年死于瑞典巡演大巴车祸。来自 Flotsam and Jetsam 的 Jason Newsted 首次以成员身份出现在 The $5.98 E.P.: Garage Days Re-Revisited（1987）和 …And Justice for All（1988）。黑专（1991）拿掉早期鞭挞写法、加重贝斯，仅美国约卖 1500 万张。书中写 1992 年与 Guns N’ Roses 紧张的联合主打以 Metallica 占上风结束。随后是 Garage Inc.（1998）与 S&M（1999，旧金山交响乐团）。St. Anger（2003）与电影 Some Kind of Monster 记录戒瘾与 Newsted 离队；来自 Suicidal Tendencies 与 Ozzy Osbourne 乐队的 Robert Trujillo 接贝斯。Death Magnetic（2008）、2010 年“四大”巡演与摇滚名人堂入选写在同一段。2011 年 12 月 30 周年演出的嘉宾有 Dave Mustaine、Ozzy Osbourne、Geezer Butler、Jerry Cantrell 与 Rob Halford。

title.zh: 体育场尺度的 thrash 工艺

body.en:
Metallica matter as the thrash band that kept downpicked riff discipline while learning mass-chorus writing. Underground credibility and MTV-era reach share one catalog.

Big Four leader by sales and citation.
body.zh:
Metallica 要紧处是：在学习大众副歌写作时仍保持下拨 riff 纪律。地下信誉与 MTV 时期触达共享同一目录。

销量与引用上的 Big Four 领袖。

title.zh: Burton 时期 vs Newsted/Rock 时期

body.en:
Cliff Burton’s years are the progressive-thrash citation. Post-1986 bass change and 1991 production shift create distinct versions under one name.

Hammett after Mustaine: lead-guitar continuity with a different origin story.

Early chairs also include McGovney and a short Grant guitar credit on Hit the Lights. The 2011 anniversary bills put Mustaine, Butler (Black Sabbath), Cantrell (Alice in Chains), and Halford (Judas Priest) on the same stage.
body.zh:
Cliff Burton 年代是 progressive thrash 引用。1986 后换贝斯与 1991 制作转向造就同名下的不同版本。

Mustaine 之后的 Hammett：主音吉他连续，起源故事不同。

早期座位还包括 McGovney，以及 Hit the Lights 上很短的 Grant 吉他署名。2011 年周年演出把 Mustaine、Butler（Black Sabbath）、Cantrell（Alice in Chains）与 Halford（Judas Priest）放到同一舞台。

alt.zh: Kirk Hammett 与 Metallica，马德里，2009

body.en:
Multi-section riff piece—speed, mid-tempo crush, clean bridge. Peak of pre-mainstream song length.

Clear arrangement reference inside thrash.
body.zh:
多段 riff 长曲——速度、中速压迫、干净桥段。主流化前歌曲时长的峰值。

thrash 内部清晰的编曲参照。

body.en:
Bob Rock sheen, shorter runtime, chant chorus—thrash downpicking inside hard-rock radio format.

The turn toward 1990s mainstream metal.
body.zh:
Bob Rock 光泽、更短时长、口号副歌——hard-rock 电台格式里的 thrash 下拨。

通向 1990 年代主流金属的转折。

alt.en: Metallica at San Siro, Milan, 8 May 2019
alt.zh: Metallica，米兰 San Siro，2019 年 5 月 8 日

body.en:
Right-hand stamina and chromatic riff writing feed metalcore and modern metal. Load/Reload and Napster-era fights are separate institutional chapters.

Musical constant: Hetfield rhythm guitar.
body.zh:
右手耐力与半音 riff 写作影响 metalcore 与现代金属。Load/Reload 与 Napster 时期争端是另一些制度章节。

音乐常量：Hetfield 节奏吉他。

title.en: Work ethic lines beside the riffs
title.zh: riff 旁的工作伦理话术

body.en:
Interview excerpts about practice and touring density match the recorded attack.

Prefer process talk over mythic language.
body.zh:
关于练习与巡演密度的访谈摘句，与录音中的攻击性匹配。

宁取过程谈话，不取神话化语言。

note.en: Mustaine out, Hammett (ex-Exodus) in before Kill ’Em All. Burton died in the 1986 Sweden bus crash after the Ozzy US tour.

note.en: Newsted from Flotsam and Jetsam, first on the 1987 Garage Days EP. Trujillo, ex-Suicidal Tendencies and Ozzy’s bassist, replaced him around St. Anger (2003).
note.zh: Newsted 来自 Flotsam and Jetsam，首次出现在 1987 年 Garage Days EP。约在 St. Anger（2003）前后，前 Suicidal Tendencies、Ozzy 乐队贝斯手 Trujillo 接替。
